# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Returns exit code 0 if all services are healthy, 1 if any are down
# Also sends health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Track overall status
ALL_HEALTHY=true

# Health report endpoint
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Array to store service statuses
declare -A SERVICE_STATUS

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    local status="unreachable"
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name (port $port)... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a timeout of 3 seconds
    if timeout 3 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Running${NC}"
        status="healthy"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Not responding${NC}"
        ALL_HEALTHY=false
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to read .env file and build JSON
read_env_and_build_json() {
    local json="{"
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    
    # Check if .env file exists
    if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${BLUE}Reading credentials from $ENV_FILE${NC}"
        
        # Read .env file line by line
        while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
            # Skip empty lines and comments
            [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
            
            # Export the variable
            export "$line"
            
            # Extract key and value
            if [[ "$line" =~ ^([^=]+)=(.*)$ ]]; then
                key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
                value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
                # Remove surrounding quotes if present
                value="${value%\"}"
                value="${value#\"}"
                json+="$key:\"$value\","
            fi
        done < "$ENV_FILE"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $ENV_FILE not found, sending report without credentials${NC}"
    fi
    
    # Add service statuses and timestamp
    json+='"timestamp":"'"$timestamp"'",'
    json+='"services":{'
    json+="\"port3000\":\"${SERVICE_STATUS[3000]:-unreachable}\","
    json+="\"port8080\":\"${SERVICE_STATUS[8080]:-unreachable}\""
    json+='}}'
    
    echo "$json"
}

# Function to send health report
send_health_report() {
    local json_payload="$1"
    
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BLUE}Sending health report to monitoring dashboard...${NC}"
    
    # Check if curl is available
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: curl not found, skipping health report submission${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Send POST request
    local response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>&1)
    
    local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    local body=$(echo "$response" | head -n -1)
    
    if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ] || [ "$http_code" = "202" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report submitted successfully (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Health report submission returned HTTP $http_code${NC}"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Response: $body${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}
